# Application Questions — shared knowledge base

**Generated from `questions.jsonl` by `applier/qbank.py` — do not edit by hand.**
Every distinct question job applications have asked any job-doot user. Questions and how to
answer them only — personal answers stay in each person's own applier.

Rules: **From facts** = the applier answers from the profile; **Ask the person** = a personal
value the person gives in the dashboard Answers tab; **Never auto-answer** = sensitive, always
left for the human.

| # | Question | Category | How to answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | First name / Last name | identity | **From facts**: (split the full name). |
| 2 | Email address | identity | **From facts**: From facts. |
| 3 | Phone / mobile number | identity | **From facts**: (with country code). |
| 4 | LinkedIn profile URL | identity | **From facts**: leave blank if none. |
| 5 | Are you legally authorized to work in <country>? | eligibility | **From facts**: (authorized in India; sponsorship needed elsewhere). |
| 6 | Do you now or will you require visa sponsorship? | eligibility | **From facts**: (no for India; yes outside India). |
| 7 | Notice period | eligibility | **From facts**: From facts. |
| 8 | Current CTC / current salary | compensation | **Ask the person**: (private; from their saved answer). |
| 9 | Expected CTC / expected salary | compensation | **Ask the person**: (private; from their saved answer). |
| 10 | Total years of experience | experience | **From facts**: From facts. |
| 11 | Years of experience with <specific tech> | experience | **From facts**: 0 if the tech isn't listed. |
| 12 | Highest qualification / degree | experience | **From facts**: From facts. |
| 13 | Willing to relocate? | location | **From facts**: From facts. |
| 14 | Gender | identity | **From facts**: else "Prefer not to say". |
| 15 | Resume / CV upload | documents | **From facts**: Always available — upload the applicant's resume file. |
| 16 | Cover letter / Why do you want to join? / Tell us about yourself | free-text | **From facts**: 3–4 honest sentences from facts + the job; never invent experience. |
| 17 | Full postal / house address (Address line 1) | location | **Ask the person**: collected via the Admin/Answers tab. |
| 18 | PIN code / postal code / ZIP | location | **Ask the person**: part of the address set. |
| 19 | City / District / State / Country | location | **Ask the person**: (part of the address set). |
| 20 | Government ID — PAN / Aadhaar / passport / SSN / national ID | sensitive | **Never auto-answer**: always route to the human. |
| 21 | Date of birth | sensitive | **Ask the person**: don't guess. |
| 22 | How did you hear about us? | screening | **Ask the person**: Safe default "LinkedIn" (where most of our applies come from); or ask the person. |
| 23 | Were you previously employed here (former employee / contingent / temporary / consultant)? | screening | **Ask the person**: Usually "No" — ask the person if unsure. |
| 24 | Phone device type (mobile / landline / etc.) | identity | **From facts**: "Mobile". |
